newsitem.title: USA: American General to complete acquisition.
newsitem.headline: American General to complete acquisition.

text.p: American General Corp said on Thursday it expects to complete the acquisition of Home Beneficial Corp on April 16.
Subject to approval, Home Beneficial's shareholders may elect to have each share of their Home Beneficial common stock converted into 0.9670 share of American General common stock or $39.00 in cash.

The company said that the exchange ratio for American General common stock was based on $40.3313, the average of the daily high and low sales price of American General common stock in the 10 trading days through April 9.
Cash elections are limited to no more than 50 percent and no less than 25 percent of the aggregate consideration.

On December 22, 1996, the companies signed a definitive agreement in which American General would buy Home Beneficial for an aggregate consideration of $665 million or $39.00 per Home Beneficial share.
